messages.author: c5790e857463cacd
messages.subject: show method no longer exported.
parts:
Hello, 
Prior to the new version 1.5.0, unmarked exported a "show" method, but not it does not. Is this a deliberate change? I ask because I was importing that message into a different package. 

Thanks

JP

messages.author: 4f80e1927b0757cb
messages.subject: Re: show method no longer exported.
parts:
Hi JP,

Yes, it was deliberate as part of an attempt to clean up unnecessary duplication in the package's exports. Previously there was both show and summary exported and they returned essentially identical information. The show() method now just calls the summary() method, and the latter should still be exported. Will summary() work for what you need?

Sorry for the trouble. I thought I had identified all the reverse dependency issues - is this an off-CRAN package?

Ken
